title: Almost blowup squares are stable under base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given an almost blow up square and an arbitrary morphism Y -> X, the lemma asserts that the base changed square with Y x_X E, Y x_X X', Y x_X Z and Y is again an almost blow up square (statement lines 10986-10997). The proof checks the defining properties one by one: Y x_X X' -> Y is proper and of finite presentation by Morphisms, Lemmas labelled morphisms-lemma-base-change-proper and morphisms-lemma-base-change-finite-presentation; Y x_X Z -> Y is a closed immersion of finite presentation by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-base-change-closed-immersion; and the inverse image of Y x_X Z in Y x_X X' equals the inverse image of E, hence is locally principal by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-pullback-locally-principal (proof lines 10999-11011). It then compares the closed subschemes X'' of X' and Y'' of Y x_X X' defined by the ideals of sections supported on E and on Y x_X E, observes that Y'' is the closed subscheme corresponding to the ideal of sections supported on Y x_X (E cap X''), and concludes that Y'' is the strict transform of Y relative to the blowing up X'' -> X by Divisors, Definition labelled divisors-definition-strict-transform, so that by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform Y'' is the blow up of Y x_X Z in Y (proof lines 11013-11021). Recognising the base changed square as the strict transform configuration required by the definition is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
